# Lenz 0.0.16 beta

This release adds Lenz Code editing commands and Ruby LSP fixes, in the GUI and the terminal app (PR #54).

- Gitignored files such as `.env` now appear in the explorer, the file finder and Find in Files. Ignore rules only decide which folders are entered, so `target/`, `node_modules/` and `log/` stay out.
- Ruby problems and completion follow the latest text: Lenz waits for Ruby LSP to apply each burst of edits before asking about it, so an Undo right behind a deletion no longer leaves stale syntax errors.
- Go to Definition adds gem and project declarations made by macros that Ruby LSP's index misses (`cattr_accessor`, `class_attribute`, `delegate`).
- Ruby indents two spaces by default; `.editorconfig` and the project setting still decide first.
- Delete Line (Cmd+Backspace on macOS, Ctrl+Y in the IntelliJ preset), block-aware Enter (with Ruby LSP adding `end` as its own Undo step), Copy Reference (Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C) and Go to Test or Subject (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T).
- New Scratch File shows file-type icons for its kinds while File Icons is on.

## Validation

The release commit passes the full local Linux gate. Contributor-measured costs, in release builds: the project scan is about 5% slower (76 → 80 ms on 96k files), Enter after a block opener takes 110–150 µs instead of 19 µs, and the first Ruby definition builds the gem index (about 70 ms on 817 files). See `docs/editor-follow-ups.md` for the raw numbers.

Native AppKit/macOS interaction and physical-display behavior remain unverified. Native package build/signature and CLI checks are separate from interactive validation. macOS packages are ad-hoc signed.

Keep all five executables together. Verify the matching `.sha256` sidecar before installation.

[Changes since 0.0.15](https://github.com/aantoniadis/lenz/compare/v0.0.15...v0.0.16).
